# Why the kiosk exists

<!-- mb:block id=problem preset=note label="The problem, in one note" -->
### Note: staff cannot be everywhere

Visitors arrive curious and leave unbriefed whenever the floor is busy. The kiosk is the
answer that never queues.
<!-- mb:/block -->

Showroom staff do their best work with visitors who already know what they want. The kiosk
gets everyone to that point — on their own schedule.
